If you have questions regarding Marathon Tours & Travel’s Boston Hotels please: CALL 617-242-7845 Marathon Tours & Travel is the Exclusive Domestic Travel and Accommodations Booking Agency for the Boston Marathon® presented by Bank of America. We offer the lowest rates at a wide variety of three, four and five-star hotels in the best locations. Many properties are just a short walk from the finish line in Copley Square. Managed by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.) the Boston Marathon® is the world’s oldest annual marathon, ranks as one of the world’s most prestigious road racing events and is the only Abbott World Marathon Majors race that requires a qualifying performance time. Held annually on Patriot’s Day, a holiday celebrated in Massachusetts and Maine in observance of the beginning of the American Revolutionary War, the Boston Marathon® is rich in history and tradition. The legendary point-to-point course starts in rural Hopkinton, passes through numerous quaint New England towns before finishing on Boylston Street in the heart of Boston. OFFICIAL BOSTON MARATHON® COURSE TOUR The official Boston Marathon® Course Tour is open to runners and supporters for $40 per person. It is offered Saturday at 2:00 PM and Sunday at 10:00 AM. The tour departs from the Sheraton Boston Hotel at 39 Dalton Street, Boston and tickets must be purchased in advance. Photo credit @BAA. The Boston Marathon® is an AbbottWMM Marathon Tours & Travel World Age Group Qualifying Race. Please be sure to stop by the Marathon Tours & Travel Booth! This evening enjoy the many fine restaurants, bars, and cafes in Boston. Saturday, April 18 Hide details This morning we highly recommend participating in the B.A.A. 5K, which registration is required in advance. Visit www.baa.org for details. If you have arrived today, you should also make your way to the Boston Marathon® Expo and Bib Number Pick-up, which is open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Be sure to stop by the Marathon Tours & Travel Booth! This evening enjoy the many fine restaurants, bars, and cafes in Boston. In addition, we strongly suggest you reserve a spot for the Official Boston Marathon® Course Tour. This is optional and is open to runners and supporters for $40 per person. It is offered at 2:00 PM and departs from the Sheraton Boston Hotel at 39 Dalton Street, Boston. Sunday, April 19 Hide details Enjoy a day sightseeing in Boston. The Expo is open today from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Be sure to collect your bib before the Expo closes! Today, you also have another opportunity to join the Official Boston Marathon® Course Tour at 10:00 AM. Monday, April 20 Hide details Race day! Good luck to all runners and wishing you a fabulous Boston Marathon® experience. Read the B.A.A. Boston Marathon® Timing and Scoring guidelines here. Organizer: Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.) The Course: The course follows a point-to-point route from rural Hopkinton to Boston. The course is certified per the guidelines set forth by the IAAF and USA Track and Field. Course Tour: We highly recommend booking the Boston Marathon® Course Tour. This is optional and is open to runners and supporters for $40 per person. All tours depart from the Sheraton Boston Hotel (39 Dalton Street) and tickets must be purchased in advance. We recommend bringing your Program Book so you have a map of the course. Temperature: The average weather during the month of April in the Boston area is a high of 57F and the average low is 41F. Temperature swings are common in New England in the spring. Entry Fee: Each runner must secure their bib directly with the B.A.A. Eligibility: Runners must qualify to run the Boston Marathon® by running a qualifying time at a certified marathon. Qualifying times are determined by your age on the date of the Boston Marathon® in which you will be participating. Number Pickup: All runners must bring a government issued photo ID to pick up your bib number at the Boston Marathon® Expo, which is held at the Hynes Convention Center. You can find out more information here. Awards: For information go here. Difficulty: Moderate Registration & Booking ‘Hotel Only’ Cancellation Policy (strictly enforced): In booking a hotel reservation(s) you agree to the following cancellation policy for your Boston Marathon® hotel reservation(s) through Marathon Tours & Travel (MTT). As these are special discounted room rates for the marathon event, we remain consistent with enforcing the minimum cancelation policy as outlined below. Please note that when a room is booked, this removes it from the inventory for other runners. By working together as a community, we are able to continue offering high quality service and hotel accommodations at low rates. All cancellations received: From your time of booking and through December 31, 2025 will be charged a $30 handling fee. On January 1, 2026 and through January 31, 2026 will be charged a $40 handling fee. On February 1, 2026 and through February 28, 2026 will be charged a $60 handling fee. On March 1, 2026 and until seven (7) days prior to your arrival date of your hotel reservation will be charged one nights’ room and tax. Seven (7) days or less prior to your arrival date, you will be charged the room and taxes for the total nights of your reservation. For example, if you booked three nights and canceled five days before you were to arrive, MTT will charge your credit card on file for the three room nights plus tax. ***Exception: citizenM BackBay which you will be charged one nights’ room and tax for cancellations from March 1, 2026 until fourteen (14) days prior to arrival and then fourteen (14) days or less prior to your arrival date, you will be charged the room and taxes for the total nights of your reservation. NO SHOWS will be charged the full room and taxes for total dates of the reservation, unless the hotel has a different policy. It is important to notify the hotel directly if you will not make the trip as planned, or if you are delayed and will not arrive as planned. Please check with your hotel for any additional cancellation conditions. Cancellations are charged per room reserved. Applicable charges will be applied directly to the credit card provided for your hotel room(s). Early Departure Fees to be charged by hotel should guest depart early or make changes to their stay within one week of arrival. Please contact the hotel directly for individual cancellation/change policies within one week of arrival. Abbott World Marathon Majors Age Group World Championship This event is an Abbott World Marathon Majors Marathon Tours & Travel Age Group World Championship (AGWC) Qualifying Race. If you achieve the automatic qualifying time for your age group, found here, you’ll be invited to the 2026 Age Group World Championship in Cape Town, South Africa. The qualifying period began on January 1, 2025, and will conclude on December 31, 2025. We invite you to book the official AGWC package here. If you have secured your 2025 AGWC Entry, there is still limited availability for our AGWC Hotel Package. Find details here.
